   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 2, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ysiisme_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "Love the bands and app but lately every time I use the app it freezes and if I take a screenshot it lags so hard. I have a iPhone 16pro n no other app struggles as hard as this one"
            2. _Teessiderang_, Jun 2, 2026, 1/5: "This App keeps force closing on me. It is very slow to update doesn't do it in real time like Zepp does. If it doesn't improve when it comes to buying another Mi band I think I'll look for another Brand instead Update: its still lousy and at the moment can't get the App to show me anything. Its virtually useless!!! Updated 02.06.26 have tried to factory reset device, delete and reinstalled the App and it now refuses to connect and will only show the QR code. Utterly useless. Xiaomi you have lost a loyal customer"
            3. _jeheudih7284€),?_, Jul 9, 2026, 3/5: "Application mitigate problem of giving. full of lag and bugs no correct synchronization too slow bad calculations in the running word, I have to recalculate everything and each time I have different results lack of information, does not justify the data it gives, it gives recovery times at random the pacer does not work not enough features on the application, no sport mode or performance activation so that the watch is sport focused lack of data on the application, you cannot create a route, no pre-recorded route but overall for the price it remains affordable but you can do much better with a lousy GPS"
